home.title: Book premium meeting rooms and conference rooms for your professional events.
home.lead: MeetSpace brings together room booking, seminars, workshops and meeting planning, plus parking options, to deliver a smooth professional venue experience from start to finish.
home.missionsText: A platform built for teams, organizers and companies looking for reliable, well-equipped venues for high-value professional exchanges.
home.mission1Text: Rooms designed for executive meetings, workshops, seminars and premium conference formats.
home.mission2Text: Plan professional events with clear flows for registrations, logistics and attendee coordination.
home.mission3Text: Parking, reception and support services to ensure a smooth arrival experience for teams and guests.
home.spacesText: Browse meeting rooms and conference spaces tailored to presentations, workshops, board meetings and client sessions.
home.eventsText: Follow a business-focused calendar with conferences, workshops, networking sessions and industry gatherings.
home.parkingText: Review available parking options linked to your booking to simplify arrivals for teams, speakers and attendees.

home.faqText: Short answers help visitors understand the main rules before creating an account.
home.faqBookRoomQ: How do I book a room?
home.faqBookRoomA: Choose a room, sign in, select an available slot and confirm the booking.
home.faqCreateEventA: Only organizers and administrators can create a public event. A client can book a room or register for an event.
home.faqParkingA: Yes, the parking module shows available slots, remaining spaces and the rate for each session.
home.faqPaymentA: Payments are confirmed online according to the Stripe configuration available in the environment.
home.faqCancelA: Cancellations are handled from the reservation space when the status allows it, or through support when follow-up is needed.
home.faqSupportA: The Contact page lets you send a request with a category, subject, message and optional reference.
home.finalText: Explore available rooms, events and parking options or sign in to continue your journey.

cancellation.title: Cancellation / refund
cancellation.intro: One predictable policy applies to paid rooms, events and parking bookings on MeetSpace.

sections.title: At least 48 hours before
sections.text: 100% of the paid amount is refunded, including parking options linked to an event registration.

sections.title: Between 24 and 48 hours before
sections.text: 50% of the paid amount is refunded to the original payment method.

sections.title: Less than 24 hours before
sections.text: No automatic refund is granted because capacity was held for the booking.

sections.title: Processing
sections.text: The exact amount is shown before confirmation. The Stripe refund starts immediately and then follows bank processing times.
